tool_args.rationale: The high-gradient probe reveals a sharp downturn, but the fitted threshold model failed fresh confirmation. A finer trajectory can distinguish the transition shape and constrain alternative stationary mechanisms before another confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Its zero training error but 0.702 confirmation RMSE shows that the eight observations do not identify its threshold behavior reliably.
One stationary model has failed, but the evidence does not establish nonstationarity or refute all smooth stationary mechanisms.
It does not address the mechanism ambiguity.
